theater: 突尼斯城郊（伊夫里基耶）

battle.name: 柏柏人起義
battle.theater: 突尼斯城郊（伊夫里基耶）
battle.brief: 七三九年五月，馬格里布與伊夫里基耶的柏柏爾部族起兵反叛倭馬亞哈里發國，首領梅薩拉統兵推進，阿布·雅齊德以先知身份號召，叛軍攻入突尼斯並圍城；安達盧斯亦聞風響應，直至穆薩·伊本·努薩爾在瓜達萊特河擊潰叛軍。卡面所配亞述長弓並非當年文物，而是角木複合反曲弓的源流，其形制仍延用於七三九年的北非弓兵。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 這場起義的交戰雙方，是七三九年控制北非的倭馬亞哈里發國，以及馬格里布、伊夫里基耶與安達盧斯一帶的柏柏爾部族聯盟。哈里發一方並非全由阿拉伯人組成：大馬士革的最高統治者是七二四年即位的哈里發希沙姆·伊本·阿卜杜勒·馬利克，但北非前線的指揮全落在地方總督與受羈縻的部族傭兵手上。七三七年前後接替優素福·伊本·阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼·菲赫里治理伊夫里基耶的，是同族的烏拜德·阿拉赫·伊本·烏克巴；安達盧斯方面則由總督阿卜杜勒·馬利克·伊本·穆薩坐鎮，戰局一有失利，大馬士革便改派其父穆薩·伊本·努薩爾南下接任。哈里發國在北非的常備力量，是駐紮在突尼斯城與幾個沿海據點的阿拉伯軍人，加上按部族徵召的柏柏爾兵；其中最要緊的一支，是柏柏爾首領哈立德·伊本·巴德爾所率的忠於哈里發的部族騎兵——用柏柏爾人對付柏柏爾人，是這場平叛的樞紐。起義方的組織形態則是部族聯盟：以梅薩拉·伊本·齊亞德為軍事首領，以阿布·雅齊德為宗教旗幟，周邊的伊茲納森、桑哈賈、馬斯穆達、戈馬拉等部族各自帶兵加入。安達盧斯的柏柏爾人也在本土地起兵，兩地並無統一指揮，卻在同一套宗教訴求下於同一年爆發。
countriesEn: The two parties in this revolt were the Umayyad Caliphate, which controlled North Africa in 739, and an alliance of Berber tribes in the Maghreb, in Ifriqiya and in al-Andalus. The caliphal side was not composed of Arabs alone: the supreme ruler in Damascus was the caliph Hisham ibn Abd al-Malik, who had taken power in 724, but the command on the North African front lay entirely with provincial governors and with tribal levies held in client status. The man who succeeded Yusuf ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Fihri in the government of Ifriqiya around 737 was a kinsman of his, Ubayd Allah ibn Uqba; in al-Andalus the governor was Abd al-Malik ibn Musa, and as soon as the position turned bad, Damascus sent his father Musa ibn Nusayr south to take over. The permanent force the caliphate maintained in North Africa consisted of Arab soldiers garrisoned in Tunis and in a few coastal posts, together with Berber troops levied by tribe; the most important single body among them was the tribal cavalry of the Berber chief Khalid ibn Badr, who stayed loyal to the caliph — using Berbers against Berbers was the hinge of the whole pacification campaign. The organisation on the rebel side took the form of a tribal confederation: with Maysara ibn Ziyad as the military leader and Abu Yazid as the religious banner, the neighbouring Iznassen, Sanhaja, Masmuda and Ghomara contingents brought their own men to the fold. In al-Andalus, Berbers rose in the same year in their own country; the two movements had no common command, yet they broke out in the same year under the same set of religious grievances.
people: 關鍵人物如下。起義的軍事領袖是梅薩拉·伊本·齊亞德（Maysara ibn Ziyad），出身澤納塔系的柏柏爾部族首領，據載早年曾在總督府充任稅吏的差役，熟悉各部族的分布與稅負行情；起義爆發後，由他整合各部族的兵馬，統率主力向伊夫里基耶推進。宗教上的旗幟是阿布·雅齊德·馬赫拉德·伊本·凱達德（Abu Yazid Makhlad ibn Kaydad），原是優素福·伊本·阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼·菲赫里家中的舊僕，因主人在查稅時苛待柏柏爾人，他脫離舊主，宣稱自己是先知與「勝利由真主賦予者」，自稱「曼蘇爾·比拉赫」；追隨他的是受過壓迫的柏柏爾平民與被釋放的奴隸。他死後，由其子達伍德繼承起義，把戰火重新燒回伊夫里基耶。哈里發一方的關鍵人物是烏克巴·伊本·努赫·菲赫里（Uqba ibn Nuh al-Fihri），同出菲赫里家族，是七三九年冬季自大馬士革率援軍西來的平叛主將；再有柏柏爾首領哈立德·伊本·巴德爾，他選擇站在哈里發一方，以麾下騎兵參戰，是壓垮起義的關鍵棋子。安達盧斯方面，總督阿卜杜勒·馬利克·伊本·穆薩被叛軍擊敗後，年事已高的穆薩·伊本·努薩爾奉命接任，於瓜達萊特河一線擊潰叛軍，隨後在七四〇年奉詔召回，返程途中病死。關於此戰的敘述，主要出自十三世紀伊本·伊德哈里的《安達盧斯人記述》與十四世紀伊本·赫勒敦的《阿拉伯人、波斯人與柏柏爾人史》，兩書年代相隔甚遠，數字與細節須互證。
peopleEn: The key figures were as follows. The military leader of the revolt was Maysara ibn Ziyad, a chief of a Berber tribe of the Zenata line, who is said to have early on served in the governor's tax office, which left him well informed about the distribution of the tribes and the state of their tax burden; once the revolt broke out it was he who brought the different tribal contingents together and led the main body towards Ifriqiya. The religious banner was Abu Yazid Makhlad ibn Kaydad, formerly a servant in the household of Yusuf ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Fihri; when his master dealt harshly with the Berbers in the course of the tax collection, Abu Yazid left him, declared himself a prophet and the one whose victory is given by God, and took the title al-Mansur billah. Those who followed him were oppressed Berber commoners and freed slaves. After his death his son Da'ud took the revolt up and carried the fighting back into Ifriqiya. On the caliphal side the key figure was Uqba ibn Nuh al-Fihri, of the same Fihri family, who came west from Damascus with reinforcements in the winter of 739 to command the suppression; and there was the Berber chief Khalid ibn Badr, who chose the caliph's side and fought with his own cavalry, the decisive piece on the board. In al-Andalus, after the governor Abd al-Malik ibn Musa had been beaten by the rebels, the ageing Musa ibn Nusayr was ordered to take over; he crushed the rebels at the Guadalete, and in 740 was recalled to Damascus and died of illness on the road back. The narrative of this war comes chiefly from the Thirteenth-century Book of the Andalusian by Ibn Idhari and the Fourteenth-century History of the Arabs, Persians and Berbers by Ibn Khaldun; the two books are separated by a long interval of time, so their figures and details have to be checked against each other.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長弓，嚴格說不是七三九年能指認的物件，而是代表一種仍在服役的形制：亞述弓兵所用的角與筋複合反曲弓——弓背為木，弓腹貼角與筋，兩端裝角扣，弓身短而弧度深，靠材料本身的回彈與射手肌力配合取得箭速。這種弓的後裔在七三九年的西亞與北非仍是標準配備：所謂「角筋弓」，以木為背、以角貼腹，弦槽與握把處常包覆皮革，箭鏃多為鐵製三棱或菱形，整弓長度約八十至九十厘米，弓手多半不著甲，先以弓幕壓制，再以標槍與長矛進身。柏柏爾部族的射手自幼習射，部族兵多自備弓具，這正是起義軍在數量與射程上佔優的緣由。卡面所對應的，是這一套射術體系本身：同一批柏柏爾騎兵在馬背上使用同型弓，開弦方式為「阿拔斯式」拇指扣弦，步射與騎射通用。除弓之外，起義軍與官軍的基本裝備還包括：鐵環首直劍與短匕首、以標槍為主的手投兵器、長矛、蒙皮並包鐵餅的圓盾與小圓盾、鐵片札甲與皮甲；突尼斯一線的西迪哈馬德 ribat 遺跡曾出土八世紀裝飾銅合金面罩的頭盔，正是同期北非的樣式。攻城方面，圍困突尼斯的起義軍備有撞槌、雲梯、木柵、壕溝與掘地用的工兵；守軍則靠牆頭的滾木、擂石與火把對付攀城者。卡面那件亞述長弓沒有任何一場戰役的出土記錄可以指認；能確定的只是：它在七三九年仍以形制的方式活著。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow on this card, strictly speaking, is not an object that can be identified in 739; it stands for a form that was still in service. It is the composite recurve bow of the Assyrian archers: a wooden back, horn and sinew laid on the belly, horn nocks at the two tips, a short bow with a deep curve, whose arrow speed is the product of the rebound of the materials themselves and of the muscle of the archer. The descendant of that bow was still the standard equipment of western Asia and North Africa in 739: the so-called horn-and-sinew bow, with a wooden back and a horn belly, the groove and the grip often covered in leather, iron arrowheads of three-edged or lozenge section, the whole bow about eighty to ninety centimetres long, and archers for the most part unarmoured, opening with a curtain of arrows before closing with javelin and spear. Berber shooters trained from childhood, and tribal levies largely carried their own bows with them; that is the reason the rebels held the advantage in numbers and in range. What the card corresponds to is that whole system of archery: the same Berber horsemen used the same form of bow from the saddle, stringing it in the Abbasid thumb-draw, and the mounted and foot archers were the same men. Besides the bow, the basic equipment of rebels and loyalists alike included straight swords with ring pommels and short daggers, hand-thrown weapons of which the javelin was the main form, long spears, round and small bucklers of hide covered with iron bosses, and armour of iron lamellae and of leather; the ribat of Sidi Hmad on the Tunisian coast has yielded an Eighth-century helmet with a decorated bronze-alloy face mask, a form exactly contemporary with North Africa. For the siege of Tunis the rebels had rams, scaling ladders, wooden palisades, ditches and the engineers to drive a mine; the defenders answered climbers from the wall with rolled logs, stones and torches. No excavation record can point to the Assyrian bow on the card; the only certain statement is that in 739 it was still alive as a form.
tactics: 起義軍的打法是典型的部族總動員加游擊戰。梅薩拉沒有去與哈里發軍爭奪一場野戰的勝負，而是讓各部族兵分頭襲擊內陸的稅站、徵收點與軍鎮，切斷官軍的稅源與糧道，再由輕騎隊在薩赫爾草原與阿特拉斯山間的通道上伏擊落單的分遣隊與運糧車隊，把哈里發國在馬格里布的統治網一處處剝掉。部族民兵沒有攻城器械，面對突尼斯這樣的城池就改用圍而不攻：封住海陸通道，斷水斷糧，配合掘地與火攻，逼守軍出城。反過來說，守軍若出城反擊，正中起義軍騎兵下懷——柏柏爾輕騎在開闊地帶的機動力遠高於阿拉伯步兵。烏克巴·伊本·努赫的平叛則盡量避免進入部族腹地：先取突尼斯，解除對伊夫里基耶首都的封鎖，把哈里發的旗幟重新立起來；再以哈立德·伊本·巴德爾所部為先鋒，在城郊平原上強行拉出一場決戰，把原本各自為戰的起義聯軍打散。擊潰之後改以巡邏據點、分封忠於哈里發的柏柏爾首領、以及控制山口與驛道的方式，把「打」變成「守」，用對柏柏爾人的讓步換取地方的安寧。安達盧斯一線的穆薩·伊本·努薩爾做法相似：集結兵力，逼近叛軍盤據的河谷地形，在瓜達萊特河一線決戰，一戰而定其局。
tacticsEn: The method of the rebels was a tribal general mobilisation combined with harassment. Maysara did not try to win a pitched battle against the caliphal army; he sent the different tribal contingents to strike at the tax stations, the collecting posts and the garrison towns of the interior, cutting the tax income and the supply lines of the government, and then had light cavalry lie in wait along the tracks between the Sahel plains and the Atlas mountains, ambushing isolated detachments and baggage columns, and stripping the governing net of the caliphate in the Maghreb piece by piece. The tribal levies had no siege engine; faced with a city like Tunis they fell back on a blockade that avoided assault: sealing the land and sea approaches, cutting off water and grain, and combining mining and fire to force the garrison out. On the other hand, a sortie by the defenders played straight into the hands of the rebel cavalry, for the mobility of the Berber light horse in open ground was far above that of Arab infantry. Uqba ibn Nuh's pacification avoided the tribal interior as far as possible: first he took Tunis, lifted the blockade of the capital of Ifriqiya and set the caliph's banner up again; then, with Khalid ibn Badr's men in the van, he forced a general engagement on the plain outside the city and broke up a rebel confederation that had never fought as one. After the victory he changed from fighting to holding — patrolling posts, enfeoffing Berber chiefs loyal to the caliph, and controlling the passes and the caravan roads, turning a war of conquest into a defence and buying quiet with concessions to the Berbers. In al-Andalus Musa ibn Nusayr did much the same: concentrating his forces, pressing the rebels into the river valley where they lay, and deciding the matter in a single battle on the Guadalete.
data: 能確定的數字不多，逐一列出。時間：起義爆發於七三九年五月，伊斯蘭曆一二一年；伊夫里基耶方面的戰事在七四〇年的一月至二月間被平定；安達盧斯的瓜達萊特河之戰同在七三九年；阿布·雅齊德之子達伍德在突尼斯西南的斯貝托拉被阿拔斯朝將軍阿布·阿姆魯擊敗，是七四三年；烏克巴·伊本·努赫於七四四年在斯貝托拉被自己麾下欠餉的士兵殺死，起義的最後殘部在七四四至七四五年間被清剿。兵力：起義軍的規模在後世史家筆下是「數十萬」一類的概數，十三、十四世紀的編年史常以整數形容部族聯軍，較可靠的理解是它足以同時席捲馬格里布與伊夫里基耶並在安達盧斯得到響應，但遠高於各城守軍；平叛援軍的具體名目在史籍中互有出入，可確定其量級是數萬人，以哈里發直屬的阿拉伯步兵與騎兵為骨幹，輔以效忠的柏柏爾騎兵。地理尺度：突尼斯城到內陸重鎮凱魯萬約一百六十公里，斯貝托拉在突尼斯西南約二百公里，直布羅陀海峽最窄處約十四公里，橫渡海峽本身就是一場獨立的冒險；翻越阿特拉斯山的部族通道是軍隊移動的瓶頸。裝備年表：卡面亞述長弓的形制約成於西元前七百年，比這場起義早了一千四百四十年。
dataEn: The figures that can be fixed are few, and are set out here. Dates: the revolt broke out in May 739, in the Islamic year 121; the fighting in Ifriqiya was settled between the first and second months of 740; the battle of the Guadalete in al-Andalus likewise falls in 739; Da'ud, the son of Abu Yazid, was defeated at Sbeitla to the south-west of Tunis by the Abbasid commander Abu Amr in 743; Uqba ibn Nuh was killed at Sbeitla by his own unpaid soldiers in 744, and the last remnants of the revolt were cleared away between 744 and 745. Strength: the size of the rebel host appears in later writers as a round figure of tens of thousands, and the chronicles of the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries habitually describe tribal confederations with round numbers; the more reliable reading is that it was large enough to sweep the Maghreb and Ifriqiya at once and to find an echo in al-Andalus, and far larger than the garrison of any single town. The specific figures given for the relief army differ from source to source, but the order of magnitude is certain: tens of thousands, with the caliph's own Arab foot and horse as the backbone, supported by Berber cavalry that stayed loyal. On distances: from Tunis to the inland stronghold of Kairouan is about a hundred and sixty kilometres, Sbeitla lies about two hundred kilometres to the south-west of Tunis, the Strait of Gibraltar is about fourteen kilometres wide at its narrowest so that the crossing was in itself a separate undertaking, and the tribal passes over the Atlas were the bottleneck for the movement of any army. On the chronology of equipment: the form of the Assyrian bow on the card was made about seven hundred years before the birth of Christ, some fourteen hundred and forty years before this revolt.
cause: 起義的直接原因是稅。優素福·伊本·阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼·菲赫里任內，朝廷在馬格里布推行的新稅制，把土地稅（哈拉吉）與頭目稅按部族一律攤派，且不因改信伊斯蘭而豁免；已經改宗的柏柏爾人仍被當作受保護者徵稅，遲交或無力繳納者，輕則被收押，重的連部族首領也遭逮捕甚至處決。點火的直接契機，是七三九年五月的一次大規模徵稅與逮捕命令，把數個部族同時逼到絕路。結構性的原因有三層。其一，征服之後，阿拉伯人與柏柏爾人之間始終沒有形成共同的政治軍事框架，稅吏、徵收點與軍鎮都建在部族的土地上，治理成本全落在被治理者身上。其二，柏柏爾人並非單一民族，澤納塔、桑哈賈、馬斯穆達、戈馬拉等部族各有自己的首領與糾紛，只要中央出現號召力，聯軍很容易成立。其三，七八世紀的北非存在著強烈的異端傳統，摩尼教、拜火教的餘緒與哈瓦利吉派（易巴德派）在柏柏爾人中流傳，阿布·雅齊德宣稱自己是先知並承諾推翻倭馬亞統治，正好把不滿轉化為有組織的政治神學起義。宗教動員加上稅務公平的訴求，使零散的地方抗爭在一夜之間變成跨越國界的運動。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the revolt was taxation. Under Yusuf ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Fihri the court imposed a new fiscal system on the Maghreb, levelling the land tax (kharaj) and the poll tax on chiefs across the tribes without exempting those who had converted to Islam; Berbers who had already become Muslims were still treated as dhimmis and taxed, and those who paid late or could not pay at all were imprisoned, while tribal chiefs were arrested and in some cases put to death. The immediate spark was a large tax round and a wave of arrests in May 739, which pushed several tribes to the wall at the same moment. Behind it lie three structural causes. First, after the conquest no common political and military framework ever formed between Arabs and Berbers: the tax clerks, the collecting posts and the garrison towns all stood on tribal land, and the whole cost of government fell on the governed. Second, the Berbers were not a single people: the Zenata, Sanhaja, Masmuda and Ghomara each had their own chiefs and their own quarrels, and a confederation came together easily as soon as a centre of appeal appeared. Third, in the eighth century North Africa carried strong heterodox currents — Manichaean and Zoroastrian survivals and the Kharijite Ibadis circulated among the Berbers — and Abu Yazid's claim to be a prophet, coupled with his promise to bring down Umayyad rule, turned discontent into an organised political rising with a theology of its own. Religious mobilisation joined to the demand for fiscal fairness turned scattered local resistance into a movement that crossed state frontiers overnight.
impact: 起義在七四〇年被壓下去，卻改變了北非的權力結構，並為八年後的大變埋下伏筆。直接後果是朝廷在馬格里布的統治方式被迫改變：阿拉伯駐軍大量削減，軍隊改以受羈縻的柏柏爾部族兵為主，忠於哈里發的柏柏爾首領獲得土地與特權，以安撫和分而治之取代正面鎮壓；阿布·雅齊德的旗號也就在柏柏爾人的記憶中留下了一個「先知」的名號，他的後人與支持者日後成為法蒂梅（伊斯瑪儀派）運動的源頭——九〇九年法蒂梅王朝正是靠柏柏爾庫塔瑪部的支持攻下伊夫里基耶，建立以突尼斯為首都的政權，把阿布·雅齊德的旗號推到了極致。更長期的影響是柏柏爾人作為「決定性變量」的身分：七五〇年的阿拔斯革命之所以能推翻倭馬亞統治，阿拉伯史家伊本·赫勒敦反覆強調的正是柏柏爾部族在起義中的角色；而烏克巴·伊本·努赫在七四四年被自己的士兵殺死，也說明哈里發對邊省的控制在起義之後依然脆弱。安達盧斯一線同理：穆薩·伊本·努薩爾靠打贏瓜達萊特河一戰穩住了新生的倭馬亞西班牙，七四〇年他奉詔召回、途中病死，象征性地為這位征服者畫上句號。
impactEn: The revolt was put down in 740, yet it changed the structure of power in North Africa and laid the ground for the upheaval eight years later. The immediate consequence was that the method of ruling the Maghreb had to be altered: the Arab garrisons were cut back heavily, the armies came to rest on Berber tribal levies in client status, and Berber chiefs loyal to the caliph were given land and privileges, so that conciliation and divide-and-rule took the place of open repression. Abu Yazid's banner was thus left in Berber memory as the name of a prophet, and his descendants and followers became the source of the Fatimid (Ismaili) movement: in 909 the Fatimids took Ifriqiya with the support of the Berber Kutama and founded a state with its capital at Tunis, carrying Abu Yazid's flag to its extreme. The longer effect was the standing of the Berbers as a decisive variable: Arab historians such as Ibn Khaldun laid much of the weight of the Abbasid revolution of 750, which overthrew Umayyad rule, on the part the Berber tribes played in that rising; and the killing of Uqba ibn Nuh by his own men in 744 showed how fragile caliphal control of the frontier provinces remained even after the revolt. The same holds in al-Andalus: Musa ibn Nusayr stabilised the new Umayyad Spain by winning the battle of the Guadalete, and in 740, recalled to Damascus and dead on the road, he was symbolically closed out as a conqueror.
result: 結果是起義在戰術上失敗。伊夫里基耶方面，烏克巴·伊本·努赫·菲赫里的援軍在一二月份抵達突尼斯，解除對城市的封鎖，並在城郊擊潰起義主力；梅薩拉·伊本·齊亞德被俘（傳說中他是在一次奔逃中墜馬被擒），隨後被押往大馬士革處決，首級送回哈里發面前。阿布·雅齊德退回馬格里布內陸，於七四〇年病死，其子達伍德接過旗號，在伊夫里基耶再戰三年，七四三年在斯貝托拉被阿布·阿姆魯擊敗陣亡，餘部在七四四至七四五年間被清剿，柏柏爾人的第一次跨國大起義就此收場。安達盧斯方面，穆薩·伊本·努薩爾在七三九年瓜達萊特河之戰中擊潰安達盧斯的柏柏爾叛軍，叛軍首領陣亡，總督阿卜杜勒·馬利克·伊本·穆薩被召回，局面重歸倭馬亞。整體而言：七三九至七四五年是北非柏柏爾人口第一次以獨立政治訴求挑戰正統哈里發國的時期，起義未能推翻哈里發統治，卻把柏柏爾人的政治軍事角色推到了前台，也把倭馬亞王朝在北非的根基推向崩解的斜坡——七五〇年大馬士革易幟，正是這條斜坡的終點。
resultEn: The outcome was a tactical defeat for the revolt. In Ifriqiya the relieving force of Uqba ibn Nuh al-Fihri reached Tunis in the first or second month, lifted the blockade of the city, and broke the main body of the rebels in the plain outside the walls; Maysara ibn Ziyad was taken prisoner — the story goes that he was caught when his horse fell during a flight — and was carried to Damascus and executed, his head sent back to the caliph. Abu Yazid withdrew into the interior of the Maghreb and died there in 740; his son Da'ud took up the banner and fought on in Ifriqiya for three more years, until in 743 he was beaten and killed at Sbeitla by Abu Amr, and the remnants were cleared away between 744 and 745, which closed the first great trans-state rising of the Berbers. In al-Andalus Musa ibn Nusayr broke the Berber rebels of al-Andalus at the battle of the Guadalete in 739, the rebel leader fell in the fighting, the governor Abd al-Malik ibn Musa was recalled, and the situation returned to the Umayyads. Taken as a whole, 739 to 745 was the period in which the Berber populations of North Africa first challenged the rightful caliphate with an independent political claim; the rising did not bring down caliphal rule, but it pushed the political and military role of the Berbers into the foreground and sent the Umayyad footing in North Africa down the slope that ended with the banner changing in Damascus in 750.
